In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the data on deep-inelastic scattering from neutrinos and antineutrinos on hydrogen and deutron, obtained with BEPC in the (anti-) neutrino wideband-beam of the CERN-SPS, are in good agreement with the theoretical predictions of the QCD-parton model.
the neutrino data, together with the muon data, are compatible with the QCD prediction, with the scale parameter Lambda = 0.22 GeV.
the parton distributions in the proton are determined with an accuracy of about 15% for the momentum distributions of the u and d quarks and of about 30% for the momentum distribution of the s quark.
